Elaine (Docs): Hey, quick docs sync — the API ref currently shows the request.body 'metadata' field as an array of key/value pairs, but the runtime accepts a string->string map. Should we update examples?
Sam: Oh! I thought we already did. Where is the example? link to PR or file?
Elaine (Docs): https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4567 file: reference/generate.md lines ~120-134
Vikram: I can take the SDK snippets — Go and JS differ right now. Go expects map[string]string, JS example uses [{k:...,v:...}]
Jordan: FYI this broke a customer's migration test yesterday (reported in #support). They sent us the old array samples and got a 400.
Elaine (Docs): k, plan: 1) fix API example to use object/map 2) update Go/JS snippets and add a short migration note 3) add a unit test in docs-ci to catch array vs object mismatch
Sam: Sounds good. Vikram can you paste the minimal Go snippet we should use?
Vikram: Go:

```go
req := client.GenerateRequest{
  Input: "summarize",
  Metadata: map[string]string{"source": "ingest", "env": "prod"},
}
resp, err := client.Generate(ctx, req)
```

Sam: And JS:

```js
const req = {
  input: 'summarize',
  metadata: { source: 'ingest', env: 'prod' }
}
const resp = await client.generate(req)
```

Elaine (Docs): Perfect. Jordan can you confirm the support ticket is ok with this change (we may need to backport note)?
Jordan: I'll ping the customer. Also adding a note in changelog entry for v1.14.1
docs-bot: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4568 by Elaine — updates examples + migration note
Sam: Do we need runtime changes? Vikram: No, runtime already accepts both shapes but the docs should prefer map. The acceptance layer normalized arrays to maps previously but that was flaky.
Elaine (Docs): I'll update reference/generate.md, examples/snippets/go.md and examples/snippets/js.md. Leaving a TODO to add an integration test to catch arrays.
Sam: ETA?
Elaine (Docs): WIP, pushing patch in ~30m
Vikram: I'll open sibling PR in SDKs to align: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk-js/pull/789 and https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk-go/pull/456
Jordan: Thx — once docs PR is merged, I'll update the support ticket and close the loop.
Sam: :thumbsup:
Elaine (Docs): Pushed. CI running. cc @eng-oncall in case tests fail.
